title: 12 Best Romantic Restaurants in Paris
description: Discover Paris's most romantic restaurants for 2026. From intimate Michelin-starred dining to charming bistros, find the perfect spot for your unforgettable date night in the City of Love.

places.name: L'Ambroisie
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The Poularde de Bresse en Vessie (Bresse chicken cooked in a pig's bladder) or the Scallops with White Truffle during season.

places.name: Septime
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The ever-evolving tasting menu, often featuring creative vegetable dishes and impeccably sourced seafood.

places.name: Le Cinq
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The 'Gratinée of onions, a Parisian specialty' for a sophisticated take on a classic, or any of their signature seafood dishes.

places.name: Le Jules Verne
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their tasting menu, which offers the best representation of Chef Anton's seasonal creations, accompanied by a fine champagne.

places.name: Frenchie
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The rotating tasting menu; always expect beautifully plated, thoughtful dishes with global influences.

places.name: Bistrot Paul Bert
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Steak Frites (the pepper steak is legendary) or the Soufflé au Grand Marnier for dessert.

places.name: Clamato
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Start with a selection of fresh oysters, then try the Raw Scallops with citrus or the Maple Syrup Tart for dessert.

places.name: Restaurant David Toutain
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Opt for one of the tasting menus to experience the full breadth of Chef Toutain's creativity, particularly his signature dishes featuring seasonal vegetables.

places.name: Plénitude - Cheval Blanc Paris
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The 'Partitions' menu, which is a culinary symphony built around different sauces, often featuring exquisite seafood and poultry.

places.name: Verjus
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The tasting menu, which changes regularly but consistently impresses with its creative pairings and thoughtful presentation.

places.name: Arpège
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The 'Terre & Mer' (Land & Sea) tasting menu, or famously, the 'Arpège Egg' – a hot-cold egg with maple syrup and spices.

places.name: Yam'Tcha
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The 'Discovery Menu' with the tea pairing – it's an essential part of the Yam'Tcha experience and incredibly well-matched to the food.
